items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Then the next is Corrine. See, that's where I was born at, Corrine.

ctx.x: It's past Chalmette. And the next little village is the Parish Road. Then the next is Corrine. See, that's where I was born at, Corrine.

And then the next is Merrillville. See? The next is Walkers, Stories, and then Highland and Ship Island Canal, or the woods, Violet. It was there, Violet. You see? Well, as I was going to say about Jimmy.
